body: The sand beneath my feet shifts as if alive, pushing against my bare toes. I glance around frantically, searching for any sign of danger, but everyone else appears oblivious, their eyes fixed on the sea beyond. Panic begins to claw at my chest, squeezing tighter each second. Before I can even consider running, an eerie silence descends—no birds chirp, no waves crash. My hands tremble slightly as I realize this place has been abandoned long ago.
